summary_1line: Indra sends Lomasa to reassure Yudhishthira about Arjuna, while Dhritarashtra laments that no warrior can defeat the returning Arjuna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Indra in his celestial court instructs the sage Lomasa to descend to earth and reassure Yudhishthira about Arjuna.
Blind king Dhritarashtra sits in his palace speaking anxiously to Sanjaya, imagining Arjuna's arrows scorching the battlefield like the sun's rays.
The ascetic Lomasa arrives in the forest of Kamyaka and beholds Yudhishthira seated among sages and his brothers.
